Rendered reports from the DeltaGain analyses. Each page is generated from a `REPORT.md`
that lives beside the code that produced it, in
[`analysis/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis) — the page and
the source therefore cannot drift.

These are working analyses. Every result is computational; nothing here has been
expressed, assayed or otherwise tested at the bench, and each report states its own
limitations.

## Available

### [Unspecific peroxygenases across 15,137 fungal genomes](upo_clades/index.html)

A census of 97,520 PF01328 proteins, phylogenetic placement onto a 187-leaf reference
tree, and a candidate list for expression. The report is as specific about what the
model cannot do as about what it can: finding active-site residues is validated 95/95,
ranking clade-V-like pockets works for ordering candidates, and predicting whether an
arbitrary protein is an active peroxygenase **is not reliable** — out-of-clade AUC 0.556
on the 19 characterized enzymes the field has. It also reports four attempts to lift that
ceiling that failed their own tests, and two errors found in the underlying genome
database.

Source: [`analysis/enzymes_UPO/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis/enzymes_UPO)

### [Candidate effectors of two *Mucor* strains isolated from *Marchantia*](mucor_secretome.html)

Secretome prediction, structure prediction for the candidate effectors, and an
AlphaFold3 interaction screen against a host receptor panel with the call threshold
derived from the panel's own controls. Also records eight silent pipeline failures found
while running it, and the upstream reference-data problems the analysis ran into.

Source: [`analysis/mucor_secretome/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis/mucor_secretome)

## Not published here

Work that is in the repository but has no page here:

- **The delta-gain funnel itself** — the novelty-yield measurement this project is named
  for. It has run in full; the plan, status log and findings live on lab storage
  (`BFD/DeltaGain/docs/`) rather than in this repository. A page is being prepared.
- **The BFD gene-model and annotation findings** —
  [`analysis/enzymes_UPO/bfd_findings/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis/enzymes_UPO/bfd_findings).
  Summarized in §6 of the UPO report above. It has no page of its own because its main
  result — that the start/stop-codon completeness flags are wrong database-wide — was
  fixed upstream the same day it was found, so its tables describe a snapshot that is
  being rebuilt, and its most interesting observation (≈2,265 ascomycete proteins placing
  in a basidiomycete clade) is explicitly unresolved pending a test the report specifies
  but does not run.
